notes: I sampled three test files (test_reconcile, test_watch_lifecycle, test_lock). Each module docstring cites spec IDs (FR ranges, US, research S-3), the same IDs appear in the docstrings of sync.py, watch.py and lock.py, and tasks.md ties each test file and scenario to specific FRs. However, individual test functions carry no ID of their own, so a single failure only points to an FR range rather than one requirement. For the e2e tests, reaching the code means matching IDs across docstrings rather than following a direct link.
